findings.text: the plan's shape-control rows (`FieldComponentConstraint` at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:1412, `BoundingBoxTarget` at :1685, plus `IsofluxConstraint`, `XPointConstraint`, `WallGapConstraint`) re-encode the set that `inverse.Constraint`/`ConstraintData` already owns — psi/br/bz data at control points with null/radial/vertical index selection, generated from `ControlPoints` — so a second representation of the same pulse-design targets now lives beside the original, and a third module `nova/equilibrium/shape_inverse.py` then re-poses the inverse step `InverseDesign.solve_current` already performs.

findings.text: the plan's Thomson work (§3, §4 C, decision `thomson-crossing-source`) and its "typed crossing-point contract with uncertainty" are designed without citing the existing uncertainty-carrying pin representation `ConstraintPinSet`/`IsofluxPin`/`PinUncertainty`, which already types isoflux pairs and moment (centroid) pins — the observables §3 wires — so the plan adds a parallel contract rather than reconciling with the one already in the tree.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new module hides the augmented-system assembly, the compensator selection and the receipt shape behind a small typed protocol (`ConstraintPair` = functional + compensating unknown + binding) carried as one static tuple on the solve request; the per-observable classes are distinct physics, not shallow wrappers over one another.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan re-expressed the pulse-design bounding-box/field/null constraint set as a second vocabulary in `nova/equilibrium/constraint.py` instead of extending its existing owner `nova/equilibrium/inverse.py`.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan's design sections cite the machinery they build on (`nova/equilibrium/inverse.py` Constraint and `ControlPoints` in `nova/geometry/plasmapoints.py`, `observe_moments`) and the landed `predict_thomson` calls the pre-existing kernel `nova/equilibrium/observation_kernels.synthesize_thomson` rather than re-deriving it.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one wrapper the plan adds over existing solver machinery, `nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py`, states its justification in code (it reuses the production merit, backtracking, trip structure and acceptance, replacing only the inner solve), which is the extension the item asks for.
